Hi,

I have some issue with the heatmap. I am using the latest version of MSstats daily (2.3.5) and R (3.1.1). The intensity of the heatmap also not as bright as before when I do the same analysis as I did before which was between September to October last year. Really appreciate if somebody can help me with this. Many thanks.

Hafiz
